scripts.webpack: rm -rf dist && node build.js webpack && node run.js webpack
scripts.rspack: rm -rf dist && node build.js rspack && node run.js rspack
scripts.webpack:async: rm -rf dist && ASYNC=1 node build.js webpack && node run.js webpack
scripts.rspack:async: rm -rf dist && ASYNC=1 node build.js rspack && node run.js rspack
scripts.rspack:pin: rm -rf dist && PIN=1 node build.js rspack && node run.js rspack
scripts.rspack:async:pin: rm -rf dist && ASYNC=1 PIN=1 node build.js rspack && node run.js rspack
scripts.all: for s in webpack rspack webpack:async rspack:async rspack:pin rspack:async:pin; do echo "### $s"; npm run -s $s; done
